vogtland.title: stay one more day
vogtland.subtitle: what else there is to do in Vogtland

entries.title: for the obligatory photo
entries.distance: 15 min · largest brick bridge in the world
entries.desc: 26 metres above the valley and 98 arches — you only grasp the scale from below. The loop underneath takes a good half hour.

entries.title: for the morning after
entries.desc: The local sea. Lido, pedal boats and enough lawn to sleep off a wedding morning.

entries.title: for five minutes of medieval
entries.distance: 2 min from the church · castle & museum
entries.desc: Right above the church — if you arrive early, walk up for the best view over Mylau.

entries.title: for water & a blanket
entries.distance: approx. 55 min · spa town & radon baths
entries.desc: A spa town in the Erzgebirge with thermal baths and a spa park — the calmest way to let a long wedding night settle. Easy to fold into the drive home.

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.sentBody: Your reply is with us. See you on 07.08.!

kuchen.title: cake table
kuchen.intro: In the afternoon there's coffee and a table of whatever you bring. So we don't end up with eight cheesecakes: note down what you're contributing.
kuchen.sentBody: We'll add your cake to the list.
kuchen.emptyLabel: still empty — be the first layer
